title: pending_sc deferred dispatch pattern avoids TUI unresponsiveness
description: The pending_sc pattern stores a StateChange from the select! arm and dispatches it AFTER select! returns. This prevents a long await (Message/changes + Message/get) from blocking all other select! arms (keyboard, tick, SSE status) during that call. A future contributor might see this as unnecessary indirection and inline the await back into the select! arm — which would re-introduce TUI lag under any SSE event. The comment is accurate and should be kept.
